Maya Nguyen: Quick sync — 3pm webinar tomorrow. Need final Zoom + recording + HubSpot routing check. Who owns post-edit + clip delivery? :wave:
Rob - Events Ops: I can take post-edit. Will need the raw SRT and the speaker list by EOD today. Who's handling the transcript auto-clean?
Maya Nguyen: Thanks Rob. @Anya can you own transcript tidy + timestamps? We want 3x 90s clips for socials.
Anya Patel: Yep I got transcript tidy. Will run the cleanup script and pull timestamps. ETA 6pm PST.
Liam O'Connor: For HubSpot routing — confirm we want registrants who watched >50% to get nurture path A, others to path B. Also need to ensure UTM params survive the replay link.
Maya Nguyen: Correct on >50% => path A. UTM passthrough is a must. @marcom-bot can we add a tag "webinar:demo-apr2026" on replay click?
marcom-bot: will do — adding tag on event: "replay_click" with property tag=webinar:demo-apr2026.
Rob - Events Ops: Zoom settings — recording to cloud, separate audio tracks, enable SRT captions. Also enable auto-join for panelists. Quick config I pushed to the room:
```
Settings:
  cloud_recording: true
  audio_tracks: separate
  srt_captions: enabled
  participants_on_hold: false
  auto_join_panelists: true
```
Rob - Events Ops: I'll export the SRT and drop into GDrive under /webinars/2026-04-demo/raw/ once recording ends.
Anya Patel: For clipping, I need markers. Can presenters drop timestamps in chat during the session? That works best.
Maya Nguyen: Yes — ask speakers to post "CLIP: mm:ss - mm:ss" in chat. I'll remind them in preflight.
Liam O'Connor: HubSpot mapping for watch thresholds: set custom property `webinar_watch_pct` and workflow: if >=50 then add list "demo-warm", else "demo-cold". Also set contact property `last_webinar` = 2026-04-demo.
Maya Nguyen: Perfect. Also we need a fallback: if cloud recording fails, local RTMP fallback should stream to our backup S3 ingest. @zoom-bot can we verify RTMP fallback is wired?
zoom-bot: RTMP fallback check: configured -> yes; last test (2026-03-20) successful.
Rob - Events Ops: I'll run a heartbeat deploy 30m before start to validate recording path. Will post in here when green.
Anya Patel: One more — captions QA: I'll run quick tidy + spellcheck and then export two variants: full transcript and clip-ready markers.
Maya Nguyen: Owners recap: Rob = recording + export + fallback; Anya = transcript tidy + clips; Liam = HubSpot mapping + UTM check; Maya = speaker preflight + remind clip chat markers. Everyone OK? :thumbsup:
Liam O'Connor: 👍 all set.
Rob - Events Ops: 👍 will post export link here after job completes.
marcom-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Send post-event email w/ replay & clips" at 2 hours after event end.
Maya Nguyen: Awesome — thanks team. I'll drop the preflight checklist in #marketing 2 hours before.
